versions.content: Data reception policy By aggregating a BswDataRecep- tionPolicy a BswInternalBehavior specifies the detailed reception policy of the referred VariableDataPrototype . Note the reception policy is the same for all reception points - defined via BswModuleEntity . dataReceivePoint - of the re- spective VariableDataPrototype in this module.
